verdict.rationale: The GitHub README says Firecrawl can "Discover all URLs on a website instantly" (gh-4), which matches the story. It presents this as separate from full-site crawling (gh-3), which fits the 'without fully crawling it' part. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs for the URL-discovery endpoint (parameters, limits, how discovery works), and independent or hands-on corroboration of speed and completeness.
